statement: Small businesses recording Square sales in GnuCash will independently discover and adopt a free client-side double-entry multi-split converter, and at least 2 will demonstrate paid intent ($19 one-time) for saved mapping rules within 14 days without direct outreach.
scope: Sole proprietors and micro-businesses using Square for transactions and GnuCash for accounting. Excludes businesses using QuickBooks, Xero, or automated ERP sync.
falsification: Less than 15 completed CSV conversions or less than 2 paid intent signals within 14 days of public availability with zero ad spend.
